arguments.body:
Hi John,

Thanks for the meeting. Decisions: phase‑two rollout starts 2026‑02‑10; weekly status calls will be on Tuesdays at 10:00; reporting dashboard will use revised metric definitions.

Action items: Dana will circulate the revised rollout timeline by 2026‑01‑09; Priya will confirm dashboard metric definitions with the data team; all participants will prepare the phase‑two risk register before the next status call.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
